title: Mirtec: Automotive PCBA Quality Control and 3D AOI Inspection Innovations
summary: A comprehensive engineering review of Mirtec's MV-6 OMNI 3D AOI systems featured in SMT Today Magazine Issue 80. Explores 15MP CoaXPress camera architecture, 120 cm2/s inspection speed, multi-frequency quad moiré projection up to 25 mm height, <50 ppm false calls, and automotive IPC-CFX compliance.

distribution.linkedin_post: How do you inspect automotive PCBA connector pins up to 25 mm tall while scanning inline at 120 cm²/s? In SMT Today Magazine Issue 80, Mirtec showcases its MV-6 OMNI 3D AOI platform featuring 15MP CoaXPress cameras and multi-frequency quad moiré projection. Explore our technical review: https://www.smtinsider.com/reviews/mirtec-3d-aoi-automotive-pcba-review #SMT #3DAOI #AutomotiveElectronics #Inspection #ElectronicsManufacturing #QualityControl
distribution.forum_answer: Tall automotive connectors (>5 mm) often cause phase discontinuity errors with single-frequency moiré 3D AOI. According to technical specifications in SMT Today Issue 80, Mirtec's MV-6 OMNI resolves this via digital multi-frequency quad moiré projection, measuring pin height up to 25 mm with ±2 µm accuracy while maintaining a false-call rate below 50 ppm.
